name: skylark_look_up_trip
intent: Look up a SkyLark trip by confirmation code
description: Open SkyLark Air My Trips, select the trip matching the given confirmation code, and report where that trip goes.
patterns: find my trip with my confirmation code

inputs.description: Confirmation code of the trip to look up.

steps.intent: Open the trip showing confirmation code {{trip_confirmation_code}}
